description: This file defines the 'Cheque' class in the OpenCart system, specifically under the namespace for the catalog payment extension. It contains methods to retrieve payment options, in particular for cheque payments, and interacts with configuration and geo zone models.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Represents the cheque payment method in the OpenCart system, extending the base Model class, providing functionality for retrieving cheque payment options based on store configuration and geographical zones.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Determines available cheque payment methods based on the current customer address and store configuration, returning an array of payment options.
